basic_info.description: Big $50,000 price improvement. Live in the heart of San Francisco and walking distance to everything - steps from LinkedIn, Yelp, Facebook, SF MOMA, multi-Michelin starred Benu restaurant, galleries, shopping and more. The perfect JR 1BR/1BA urban home at One Hawthorne, Residence 18B is highlighted by panoramic views of the city, a peak at the Bay Bridge and located on the quiet, back side of the building away from the street. This upgraded, pride of ownership residence,  features include: a bedroom alcove with large walk-in closet, a living area with large picture windows, a fab white kitchen with soft close cabinets and under cabinet lighting, Bosch appliances, a generous bathroom with soaking tub, air conditioning, wood flooring throughout, new paint and much more. This well managed building features a gorgeous 24-hr attended lobby, the most spectacular 26th floor roof top terrace with BBQ and entertaining spaces and a fitness center. Walk to the Ferry Building for the Farmers Market, walk to Oracle Park for a Giants game, walk to Union Square for world class shopping. Live It Up in San Francisco's newest and most vibrant neighborhood.
